title: Ineffective
text: Ineffective. I looked forward to the flexible head and silicone bristles, believing these features would make the brushes better at cleaning the bowl.  I’m disappointed that the head is not as flexible as advertised, and the bristles were stiff and sparse.  After using the brush, I had to reach my hand into the bowl to clean it thoroughly.  I already threw my old brushes away, so now I’ll be forced to buy new brushes.  The only nice feature is their style.  They are very attractive.

product_metadata.title: Sellemer Toilet Brush and Holder Set for Bathroom, Flexible Toilet Bowl Brush Head with Silicone Bristles and Stainless Steel Handle, Compact Size for Storage, Ventilation Slots Base (Black)
features: Easily Clean Dead Corner: The flat brush head can be bent to fit the angle of the rim perfectly, reaching under the rim. The tip of the brush head is designed to clean the edge of the toilet bowl better by bending the brush head upward.
Ventilation Slots Base: The interior of the holder is a drip slot to achieve a better drain. No ponding water leaks from the bottom of the base anymore, solving the hygienic problem greatly.

No Hair Tangling Troubles: Larger bristles make it not easy to entangle hair and other dirty foreign objects. Getting rid of hair by simply rinsing the brush head. Save your time fixing cleaning problem and hair-tangling troubles. Instead of using plastic bristles, Sellemer Toilet Brush uses silicone bristles, which can protect toilet bowl from being scratched also.

Durable and Non-rusting Handle: Toilet brush handle is made of Stainless Steel material. The handle can be completely connected without gaps, preventing sewage from entering the handle. No rusty handles problem. Reduce the frequency of replacing toilet brushes due to rust.

Multifunction Usage: Not only for toilet bowls, Sellemer Toilet Brush can also be used to clean sink, wash basins and bathtubs! Thanks to silicone bristles, Sellemer Toilet Brush has stronger friction than traditional toilet brushes, spending less time and less strength cleaning ceramic objects.
